'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jan Westergard LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''A Road too long to mention'''. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

== Transcription notes ==

* Lines marked ''(illegible)'' could not be read on the scan; the sheet's partial text is shown.
* Name box reads "JAN" only; the sheet follows his Dark list (page 117) in the PDF.
* The deck name has a scribbled-out word before "A Road too long to mention".
* Line 2 is written "Ta…" and the rest is illegible.
* Line 39 has a scribbled-out word before "A Few Maneuvers". Line 51 "Move to Attack Position" is struck through and "Taking Them With Us" written beside it with the (V) box checked.
* Lines 12, 14, 22, 32, 37, 40 and 55 and shields 5 and 6 are shown as written; the exact card could not be identified.
* Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
